keyPoints: Jab tribhuj ki unnat na pata ho to Heron ka sutra kaam aata hai — sirf teenon bhujaon ki lambai chahiye, unnat nahi — yehi iski khubi hai.
Pehle ardh-parimap s = (a+b+c)/2 nikaalo, phir kshetrafal = √[s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)] — charan-dar-charan chalao, pehle koshthak phir guna.
Udaharan: 5, 6, 7 bhujaon me s = 9, kshetrafal = √(9x4x3x2) = √216 ≈ 14.7 varg ikai — calculator se vargmul nikalo.
Samabahu tribhuj (bhuja a) ka kshetrafal = (√3/4)a² — Heron ka sutra lagane par yehi saral roop milta hai.
Chaturbhuj ka kshetrafal use vikarn se do tribhujon me baant kar, dono par Heron laga kar nikaalo.
Sutra lagane se pehle jaancho ki bhujaen tribhuj asamanata poori karti hain, warna vargmul me rinatmak aayega — jo asambhav hai, isliye jaanch zaroori hai.
Aam galti: s ki jagah poora parimap rakh dena — sutra me s ardh-parimap hai, isliye 2 se bhaag mat bhoolo.
